scenes.headline: Something’s stuck. / Everyone calls me
scenes.say: Every time something in this branch gets stuck, everybody calls the Branch Manager to fix it.

scenes.headline: One person to keep it / all running
scenes.say: That's the seat we're hiring for, here in Chaguanas: one person to keep everything we've built up and running.
scenes.sub: The Branch Manager’s own hire: his personal assistant, for the systems.

scenes.headline: Thirty-six files. / A hundred thousand lines
scenes.say: So we wrote our own software. Thirty-six files, about a hundred thousand lines. And nobody here was hired as a developer.

scenes.headline: Five platforms. / How they fit together
scenes.say: Everything we've built runs across five platforms, and you'd learn how they fit together: the workflow, and the rules behind every one.

scenes.headline: Logged, routed, / signed for
scenes.say: The Log Book. Every document that leaves this branch is logged, routed, and signed for on a phone.

scenes.headline: A letter before it lapses
scenes.say: The Premium Due Desk. Before a policy lapses, the client gets a letter, and a person checks every single one.

scenes.headline: Line by line, / before anybody pays
scenes.say: Group billing. Every invoice from the insurer is checked line by line against our own records, before anybody pays it.

scenes.headline: Stuck on the server? / You sort it out
scenes.say: And when something's stuck on the server, you find out why, you fix it, and you write the amendment, so it doesn't happen again.

scenes.headline: Skills worth a line on your CV. / The keys, not a request form
scenes.say: The branch pays for every tool, with Claude right beside you. You use them every day, they're skills worth putting on your CV, and you get the keys, not a request form.
tools: beside you, on the real work

scenes.headline: HELP 868. / Our new WhatsApp line
scenes.say: And the next big thing is our new WhatsApp line, Help eight six eight. It works with Claude, and with Salesforce, and it needs one person to make it brilliant.

words3: Tell us what you would fix.
scenes.say: We're hiring one personal assistant, here in Chaguanas. If you're the one who makes it happen, come and build with us.
